title: Union operator (,) preserves ordered areas for AREAS/INDEX/SUM error order and gives #REF! in ROWS/COLUMNS/ROW
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527, the parenthesized union operator (A,B) constructs an ordered multi-area reference rather than merging areas: AREAS((A1:B2,C3,A4)) = 3, INDEX((A1:A3,C1:C3),2,1,2) selects from the second area, ISREF((A1,B2)) = TRUE, and SUM((A2:B2,A1:B1)) returns the first error in union area order (#DIV/0!) rather than sheet row-major order (#N/A). Functions requiring a single rectangular reference return #REF! (ROWS((A1:A3,B1:B2)), COLUMNS((A1:A3,B1:B2)), @ROW((A1,B2)), @COLUMN((A1,B2))), MATCH/XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP/LOOKUP return #N/A, TYPE((A1,A2)) returns 16, and cross-sheet unions (=SUM((S1!A1,S2!A1))) return #VALUE!.
basis: Measured across Excel 16.0.20527 in cfunc_m3_6 (reference_result rows 10, 24, 47; lookup_edges rows 147, 154-155, 436, 442, 447, 454, 462, 472), cfunc_m1_2 (error_order row 72), dc_nzpw (rows 93, 110), and 2026-10-23 Excel 16.0 checks in refops.rs / l1.rs.
